capability.summary: Search one openFDA drug-label query and return one record
capability.description: Calls openFDA's fixed drug label endpoint with the first CLI argument as the search expression and a fixed limit of one result. It returns regulatory label data, including provider error bodies in the shared success envelope, rather than diagnosing or recommending medication.
capability.problem_space: OpenFDA drug-label record lookup; not clinical diagnosis, prescribing, adverse-event interpretation, or full pharmacovigilance analysis.

constraint.io_signature: Input: search expression at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope containing openFDA drug-label result, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one openFDA drug-label search expression, commonly an exact field query such as openfda.brand_name:ASPIRIN
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.fda.gov/drug/label.json with search=<argument> and limit=1
no caller control for limit, skip, page, sort, endpoint, or database; all CLI arguments after position 1 are ignored
wrapper does not locally paginate, parse, or truncate the response beyond the API limit=1
missing input is not validated by the wrapper and can yield a provider response
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing one openFDA drug-label result, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: diagnose a patient or recommend treatment
search adverse-event analytics or clinical trials
